admission.justification: The overlay cuts letters and reduces readability across every view. The developer explicitly requested removing the global strip, not merely dimming or hiding it on task pages.

alternatives.option: Remove the globally mounted scanline overlay, its CSS and flicker; do not expose a switch to restore it.
alternatives.reason: The overlay cuts letters and reduces readability across every view.

alternatives.option: Keep the global CRT strip over the application.
alternatives.reason: The developer explicitly requested removing the global strip, not merely dimming or hiding it on task pages.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A later developer-approved global rendering design explicitly replaces this readability choice.

consequences: Alarm pulse and the effects-off animation freeze remain; the effects cascade name is an empty ordering slot, not an overlay.
context: D223 contrasts the proposal with the built dashboard global CRT strip; architect ruling a407a3e3 keeps the empty effects cascade slot.
